error.artwork.notAnImage: SavePoint can use PNG, JPEG, and WebP pictures, and that file isn't a whole one of those. Choose a different picture.
error.artwork.tooLarge: That picture is bigger than {maxMegabytes} MB. Choose a smaller one.
error.capture.cancelled: The snapshot was canceled. Your earlier snapshots are untouched.
error.capture.linkedFolder: A folder inside the game is a shortcut to another place on this computer, and SavePoint can't safely take a snapshot or switch files through it. Replace the shortcut shown below with a real folder, or move it out of the game folder, then try again.
error.capture.nestedRepository: {count, plural, one {A folder in the game has its own hidden change-tracking folder, usually because a mod was downloaded with a developer tool. SavePoint can't take a snapshot of it.} other {# folders in the game have their own hidden change-tracking folders, usually because mods were downloaded with a developer tool. SavePoint can't take a snapshot of them.}} Move the hidden folder shown below out of the game folder, then try again.
error.catalog.corrupt: SavePoint couldn't read one of the files where it keeps your games and profiles, so it left the file exactly as it is. Close SavePoint and open it again: it will offer to restore the last good copy or to start again.
error.compaction.cancelled: Freeing up space was canceled. Nothing was lost, and you can run it again any time.
error.compaction.preempted: Freeing up space paused so something else on this game could go first. Nothing was lost, and it runs again by itself after the next snapshot.
error.consentMarker.conflict: That folder already belongs to a different game in SavePoint.
error.consentMarker.missing: This folder has not been confirmed for SavePoint yet. Open Edit game and choose Save changes to confirm it.
error.diskSpace.low: There's not enough free disk space to take this snapshot right now. {os, select, windows {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on drive {drive} and try again.} other {Free up {hasShortfall, select, yes {about {shortfall}} other {some space}} on the disk that holds the folder below and try again.}}
error.game.notFound: That game isn't in your library anymore, so SavePoint couldn't do that. Go back to your games and try again.
error.gameService.alreadyExists: That game is already in your library.
error.gameService.folderMismatch: That {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} holds only {presentCount} of the {recordedCount} files in its latest snapshot, so it may be the wrong one. Check the location, or confirm it if you meant to use it.
error.gameService.gameRunning: {gameName} is running right now, so SavePoint can't do that yet. Close the game, then try again.
error.gameService.noHistoryToReconnect: SavePoint can't find that game's snapshots anymore, so it can't be reconnected. Add the game as a new one instead.
error.gameService.pathOverlap: That folder overlaps with {conflictingGameName}, which you already added. Pick a different location for one of them.
error.gameService.profileActive: This profile is loaded now. Play a different profile first, then delete this one.
error.gameService.reconnectable: That folder has snapshots from a game you removed. Add it as a new game to reconnect them, or choose a different folder.
error.git.unavailable: SavePoint can't run the built-in tool it uses to take snapshots and put your files back. Reinstall SavePoint to repair it, then open the app again.
error.gitOperation.amendNotAvailable: SavePoint can't replace that snapshot right now. Keep the session as a new snapshot or a new profile instead.
error.gitOperation.checkoutFailed: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. SavePoint picks up where it left off and won't redo the work it already finished.
error.gitOperation.failed: SavePoint couldn't finish that. Try again, and if it keeps happening, the details may say why.
error.gitOperation.unreadableFile: SavePoint can't read the file shown below, so it can't tell whether it changed. Check that your account is allowed to read it (it may belong to another account or be marked private), then try again.
error.history.pointNotFound: That snapshot isn't in this game's history anymore, so SavePoint couldn't go back to it. Open History again and pick another one.
error.launch.completionNotOffered: SavePoint can't keep this session that way. Pick one of the choices it offers after playing.
error.launch.detachedCaptureNotSupported: You're on an older snapshot of this profile. Go back to its latest snapshot before keeping new progress.
error.launch.dirtyWorkingTree: Some files in your game folders changed since the last snapshot. Press Play to choose whether to keep or discard them.
error.launch.fileFolderClash: {kind, select, folderHoldsFiles {SavePoint needs to put a file named {name} in your {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}}, but there's already a folder with that name, and it holds files that aren't in any snapshot (one is shown below). SavePoint won't delete your files, so it changed nothing. Move or delete the files in that folder, then try again.} other {SavePoint needs to put a folder named {name} in your {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}}, but there's already a file with that name that isn't in any snapshot (shown below). SavePoint won't delete your file, so it changed nothing. Move or delete that file, then try again.}}
error.launch.noActiveSession: SavePoint isn't tracking a play session for this game right now. Start the game from SavePoint to begin one.
error.launch.sessionMoved: The game's files changed outside this play session, so SavePoint can't safely keep your new progress here. Start the game again from SavePoint and play from the snapshot you want to keep.
error.launch.sessionStillRunning: The game is still running. Close it, then try again.
error.launch.spawnFailed: SavePoint couldn't start the game. Check the launch settings in Edit game.
error.launch.switchInterrupted: The last switch didn't finish, so the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} has a mix of files from two snapshots. Finish the switch, or discard the mix to bring the folder back to a snapshot.
error.launch.windowsProgram: This game starts through a Windows program, which SavePoint can't run directly on {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}. In Edit game, set how to start the game to Through Steam, or choose a program built for {os, select, macos {macOS} other {Linux}}.
error.operation.cancelled: That was canceled before it finished, so nothing changed.
error.path.missing: SavePoint still has every snapshot of this game, but it can't find the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} anymore. Choose the new location to carry on.
error.pathSafety.tier1Blocked: Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}}. SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large. Try something like {os, select, windows {C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\YourGame} macos {~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame} other {~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame}}.
error.pathSafety.tier2Blocked: Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}}. SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large. Try something like {os, select, windows {C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\YourGame} macos {~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame} other {~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/YourGame}}.
error.profile.alreadyExists: You already have a profile with that name. Pick a different name.
error.profile.noPoints: That profile has no snapshot of this folder yet, so there's nothing to go back to. Open the profile's menu and choose Take a snapshot now.
error.profile.notFound: That profile doesn't exist anymore, so SavePoint couldn't do that. Go back to the game's profiles and try again.
error.profile.notLoaded: A snapshot copies what your game folders hold now, and the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} isn't holding this profile. Play this profile first to load it, then take a snapshot.
error.removed.notFound: That snapshot isn't in Recently removed anymore, so SavePoint couldn't bring it back. It may have been deleted when you freed up space, or you may have brought it back already.
error.removed.notRestorable: SavePoint can't bring this snapshot back as a profile. It holds only saves, and the game version and mods it was played with were in a profile that's gone, so a profile made from it couldn't start.
error.storage.defaultFolderHasHistory: SavePoint can't start over in its default folder, shown below, because that folder already holds snapshots. To use them, choose "Find the folder" and pick this folder. To start over instead, move that folder somewhere else first; the snapshots go with it.
error.storage.folderHasLink: That folder has a shortcut in it, shown below, and SavePoint won't go through it. Remove the shortcut from that folder, or choose a different folder.
error.storage.noHistoryHere: That folder doesn't hold your games' snapshots. Choose the folder SavePoint was using before, the one with a folder for each of your games inside it.
error.storage.removeFailed: SavePoint couldn't remove the item shown below. It may be read-only, or your account may not be allowed to delete it. Fix that or remove it yourself, then try again.
error.storage.stillReachable: SavePoint can reach the folder where it keeps your snapshots, so there's nothing to find or start over from. To use another folder, move your snapshots from Settings.
error.storage.unreachable: SavePoint can't reach the folder where it keeps your snapshots. If it's on a drive or network share that isn't connected, connect it, then try again.
error.storage.writeFailed: SavePoint couldn't write to the folder shown below, so it didn't start there. Check that the drive has room and that the folder isn't read-only, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.cancelled: Moving your snapshots was canceled. You can try again from Settings.
error.storageRelocation.copyFailed: SavePoint couldn't copy everything to the new folder, so it kept using the old one and nothing was lost. Check that the new location has room and isn't read-only, then try again.
error.storageRelocation.destinationNotEm: That folder already has files in it. Choose an empty folder for your snapshots.
error.storageRelocation.insideInstallFol: That folder is inside the folder SavePoint is installed in, and updating or removing SavePoint deletes that folder, along with your snapshots. Choose a folder somewhere else.
error.storageRelocation.moveUnfinished: An earlier move to that folder didn't finish, so it holds part of a copy of your data. Delete what's in it, or choose a different folder.
error.storageRelocation.sourceUnreadable: SavePoint can't move your snapshots because it can't read or copy the item shown below, which is in the folder it uses now. Nothing was moved. Fix that item or move it out of the snapshot folder, then try again.
error.validation.invalidPayload: Some of these fields aren't valid yet. Check the name and paths above.
